question: Which of the following countries imports Basmati rice from India?
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Kuwait.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's have a look at the **last line** of the** fourth paragraph:**

 
 
• *In terms of volume of Basmati rice exports in 2020-21, top ten countries – Saudi Arabia, Iran, Iraq, Yemen, United Arab Emirates, United States of America, **Kuwait**__, United Kingdom, Qatar
 and Oman have a share of close to 80 per cent in total shipments of aromatic long grained rice from India.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
